hypothesis: Keeping the per-z maximum on the GPU avoids full-resolution per-plane device-to-host copies without changing the frozen ensemble computation.
models: all five existing fixed ed1 folds, equal weights, checked against embedded manifest
changes_allowed: Only where the running maximum and final device-to-host transfer occur; no fitting, new data, labels, fold changes or model selection.
order: AB for even seed-index+case-index+repeat-index, BA for odd; explicit synchronization around each timed call
hardware_scope: RTX3090 runtime and equivalence only; does not prove T4 runtime, biological accuracy, generalization, official acceptance or improved official score.
budget: Managed servidor-ia timeout30m; native PyTorch child timeout25m; exactly the scheduler-assigned GPU, four CPU threads,8GiB requested DRAM; no network code or shared-environment changes.
fallback: Keep the original v1 image if any promotion criterion fails; report all negative cases without retuning. Official mock is a separate authorized operation after final audit.
